summary: This resolution honors Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. for 118 years of service and its contributions to leadership, brotherhood, academic excellence, and community advocacy.

scores.thoughts: The bill honors Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc., and mentions its 'Go-to-High School, Go-to-College' program, which focuses on completing secondary and collegiate education. While it acknowledges the importance of education, the bill itself does not propose any spending or policy changes related to public schools; it is purely a commemorative resolution.
